# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For Blogger code articles, include developer-created or developer-modified source inline and fully visible; do not use collapsible code sections or links in place of code.
- For Blogger articles, generate a paste-ready HTML fragment without html, head, or body document wrappers, and include visible placeholders for diagram images from the accompanying PowerPoint. Preserve existing image placeholders when revising the writing.
- For Blogger articles, use natural, readable developer-to-developer prose rather than repetitive generated-sounding commentary. 
- For Blogger articles, omit source-catalog inventory and exclusion commentary; retain the actual file explanations and fully visible source listings.
- For Blogger articles, exclude Python source listings and Python commands from the HTML; retain the Python files in the workspace.
